summary: Forest Lookouts quotes an August 1929 item saying the Sand Peak lookout tower was ready for construction; no source gives later history.

events.note: Pend Oreille Review item, 1 August 1929: the Sand Peak lookout tower was ready for construction

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts groups lookouts by county; entry sits under Boundary County
County index gives Kaniksu National Forest and survey location 60N-1E-32
Item is credited to the Pend Oreille Review
The 1929 item reports the Sand Peak lookout tower as ready for construction
evidence.quote: The Sand Peak lookout tower is ready for construction.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one dated 1929 item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, plus the county index. The page headlines the entry SAND MOUNTAIN but its quoted item calls the tower the Sand Peak lookout tower, so the two names may be one site; the record keeps Sand Mountain and no correction is proposed. No build date, design, staffing, fate or present-day description appears in the sources checked. The firelookout.org Boundary County list and the firelookout.com Idaho map have no Sand Mountain entry. The 1929 L-2 cabin on the county page is under LOOKOUT MOUNTAIN, a different tower, and is not used. Record coordinates (48.5066, -116.3744) are not checked against any source.
